item.title: Ben Shelton reaches first U.S. Open final
item.description: Ben Shelton beat Frances Tiafoe in four sets to reach his first Grand Slam final. He will face Alexander Zverev on Sunday with a chance to become the first American man to win a major singles title since Andy Roddick in 2003.

item.title: Rays and Brewers become first teams to clinch playoff berths
item.description: Tampa Bay and Milwaukee became the first MLB clubs to secure 2026 postseason spots. Junior Caminero's walk-off homer carried the Rays past Houston, while the Brewers clinched with a 20-0 rout of Cincinnati.

item.title: Ohio State visits Texas in early top-five showdown
item.description: No. 1 Ohio State visits No. 4 Texas Saturday night in the season's first top-five matchup. Julian Sayin and Arch Manning lead teams with national-title ambitions in a third consecutive meeting; the Buckeyes won the previous two.
